With the Baby Journey pregnancy and toddler app, we want to create an environment of security, togetherness and joy for you as a pregnant woman and parent on your unique baby journey.

• Pregnancy calendar: Calculate BF and follow your pregnancy week by week, with detailed information about the development of the body and the fetus.
• Pregnancy statistics: Overview of how far the pregnancy has progressed and days left until expected delivery.
• Wealth of knowledge: Large collection of articles and material verified by midwives, children's nurses and experts in pregnancy health.
• Pregnancy training: Training sessions designed for you who are pregnant.
• Dietary advice: Advice and the latest information regarding dietary advice for you who are pregnant.
• Community: Connect with other pregnant women for experience exchange and support.
• Pregnancy checklists and FAQ: Everything you need to prepare for childbirth and parenthood.
• Maternity letter: Write your maternity letter directly in the Baby Journey app.
• Moodtracker: Track your pregnancy mood in the app and receive recommended content for you .
• Competitions: Take the chance to win great prizes for you as a pregnant woman or for your baby.

Child Features:
• Development: weekly updates on your child's physical and mental progress.
• Developmental Leaps Education: Understand important milestones in your child's growth.
• Parent Community: Share experiences and tips with other parents with children of the same age.
• Personalization: Content and offers tailored to your interests and needs.
• Parenting advice: Access to FAQs and expert tips on toddler parenting and development.
• Birth story: Write your own birth story directly in the Baby Journey app and share the birth stories of others.
